motivation: Concentration of native quote-update activity moves the within-hour activity midpoint away from calendar midpoint. The price displacement between these two completed-M5 locations may add directional response information after own price/location/range/activity controls. This is a new hypothesis, not evidence of order flow, efficient price or NET advantage.
feature: 12 exact completed M5 bars of last UTC H1, every tick_volume>0. k is FIRST index with 2*cumulative_tick_count>=H1total. phi=10000*ln(close[k]/close[5]); no intra-M5 price or activity interpolation.
baseline: 10 frozen compact_baseline_v2 coordinates PLUS H1 log close/open bps PLUS sqrt(sum M5 body bps squared). Same paired causal/economically screened matured rows in baseline 12 and model 13 dimensions.
model: One added continuous phi. Reuse centered online standardization from matured rows; ridge lambda10; intercept unpenalized; min32 matured pairs; no sign inversion, model clipping, parameter or winning-symbol search.
novelty: Activity MEDIAN TIME location coupled to price-path location; neither sum(volume*sign(body)) nor two-H1 aggregate price-per-tick impact, weekly matched activity, spread covariance, extrema temporal order, ordinal close-location autocorrelation or price-path occupancy. Constructive software counterexample preserves compact baseline, total H1 activity, final M5 activity and weighted-sign vote while changing phi. Broad price/activity family is not claimed new.
